ghoulkin.approach: A Ghoulkin follows running boots behind cover. Walk to lose it. If the burial slats tip and the hooked hand comes out, cut the reach with quick steel. A clean rake lets it feed.

wychwood_stalker.approach: The barred shoulder stays in sight while it circles. Watch the vanes fold low. Shoot as it gathers, or lay an iron trap on its line. With an empty quiver, cross the rush and cut as it lands.

wychwood_raider.approach: The painted gate board turns aside a quick cut or a common arrow from the front. A heavy blow opens the guard. You can also circle the board. If you answered the road call, approach with your weapon sheathed and offer an empty hand before you strike it.

wychwood_brute.approach: Iron straps run across the timber yoke. When both feet plant, leave the line of its tusks and cut the exposed flank after the swing. A bodkin can pierce the front. An iron trap buys time to get around it.

bog_wretch.approach: Moon Oil and a clean interruption can expose the carried memory. Exposing it is not the same decision as destroying it; the fragment's fate is a separate choice.

gravebound_knight.approach: When the long blade rises, let the knight commit. An uncoated light cut will draw blood but cannot stop the planted swing. Step beyond the hook and close while it pulls the haft back. A clean parry also opens the armour to Rot Oil.

bell_eater.approach: Watch the clapper and leave the bell's ring. The grave slam leaves the longest pause. Reading two disturbed graves reveals a shared pull and gives time to read its first tell. A released rope and mourning stone also matter.

rootbound_colossus.approach: The marked roots feed the armoured heart. Cross the line of the rupture while its weight is planted. Save light cuts for when its roots lift again. Redirect root channels and protect the name-board. A burning opening does not erase the human record trapped beneath it.

ashwing.approach: Cross the ash plume. When the wings gather for a pass, move across its flight and return as it slows. An Oathfire hit can interrupt charged breath. The mill's ventilation and the workers' escape are part of surviving this encounter.

halvern_boss.approach: His sword lunge gives up the turn early. Step across it or risk a clean parry to make him yield. When he lowers his blade, speak to the memory. His bounded testimony, release and defeat are different outcomes, not interchangeable victories.

white_hart_avatar.approach: Watch where a memory echo ends before the antlers follow. Cross its run early and give a sweeping rack room to pass. The covenant is a choice about the living and the dead, not a compulsory hunt. Hear the account before choosing violence.

bandit.approach: A person with a weapon is still a physical opponent. Keep your footing, guard a committed strike and leave space to retreat. Equipment does not establish why this person chose the road.

redroot_potion.body: A remedy to recover after an injury. Drinking uses one potion; it restores health immediately, up to your current maximum.

bitterleaf_tonic.body: A remedy for spent breath. Drinking uses one tonic; it restores stamina immediately, up to your current maximum.

ash_bomb.body: Equip a field tool from your pack. On the road, tap and release Tool to throw; hold it to aim first. A bomb follows an arc and bursts on contact or after three seconds of active flight. Cancel with Dodge or Aim before release without spending it.

effects.title: Blast
effects.text: 45 base damage within 6 metres of the burst, blocked by solid scenery. One bomb is spent on a valid release, even if it hits nobody.

moon_oil.body: Apply one bottle to coat your blades against spirit weaknesses for five minutes of active play, or six with Ash-Tempered Blade Fitting. Menus, dialogue, loading and time outside the game do not spend the coating. Reapplying refreshes the duration; another oil replaces it.

effects.title: Blade coating
effects.text: Gives blade contacts the spirit tag. Its effect depends on the target's weakness.

rot_oil.body: Apply one bottle to coat your blades against undead weaknesses for five minutes of active play, or six with Ash-Tempered Blade Fitting. Menus, dialogue, loading and time outside the game do not spend the coating. Reapplying refreshes the duration; another oil replaces it.

effects.title: Blade coating
effects.text: Gives blade contacts the undead tag. Its effect depends on the target's weakness.

iron_trap.body: Equip the trap, then release Tool on clear, level ground in front of Kael. An armed jaw waits for the first hostile to step into it and slows that target for four seconds. Civilians do not trigger it.

effects.title: Placement
effects.text: Up to three armed traps per region. Placements survive Save/Continue and regional returns; they do not catch anything while you are away. Invalid placement spends nothing. Traps do not block walking.

standard_arrow.body: An ordinary hunting arrow. Selecting a bundle does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. Arrows are replenished through supplies and shops, not field crafting.

bodkin_arrow.body: A heavier iron-headed shot, carried in a smaller bundle. Selecting it does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. The comparison below is base impact damage before a target's response.

ashfire_arrow.body: An arrow wrapped with an ember-bright head. Selecting it does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. The comparison below is base impact damage before a target's response.

known_use.title: The name you restored
known_use.body: The chapel names and ritual stones give time to read the Bog Wretch's approach. Moon Oil and clean interruptions can expose its memory. Preparation offers an opening; no purchase is required to decide how to answer the account.

known_use.title: Mira's refined formula
known_use.body: Your learned formula returns one mooncap after a successful craft. You still need the full recipe in hand to begin; the quote shows both the required ingredients and the return.
